question:
**Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The patient was happy that he was given **__ancient__ **methods of treatment to cure her health condition.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Modern.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Ancient**: Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence. (प्राचीन)
 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of the given words in the options section.
 
 
• **Multiple**: Having or involving several parts, elements, or members. (एकाधिक)
 
• **Modern**: Relating to the present or recent times as opposed to the remote past. (आधुनिक)
 
• **Slow**: Moving or operating, or designed to do so, only at a low speed; not quick or fast. (धीमा)
 
• **Primitive**: Relating to, denoting, or preserving the character of an early stage in the evolutionary or historical development of something. (प्राचीन)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of '**Ancient**' is '**Modern**'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.
